files.README.md:
# Documentation Skills

Write consistent, high-quality documentation without starting from scratch. This skill suite gives your AI coding agent specialized knowledge for 9 types of documentation, from READMEs to API references to changelogs.

## Features

- **Intelligent routing** -- `/docs` analyzes your request and dispatches to the right specialist
- **9 documentation types** -- purpose-built skills for READMEs, APIs, tutorials, how-tos, and more
- **Shared reference materials** -- writing best practices, templates, editing checklists, and audience guidance baked into every skill
- **Works across agents** -- compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and 40+ other AI agents via the [Agent Skills spec](https://agentskills.io/specification)

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|-------|--------------|
| `/docs` | Router -- picks the right skill for your request |
| `/docs-readme` | Create or improve README files |
| `/docs-getting-started` | Quickstart guides that get users to "first success" fast |
| `/docs-howto` | Step-by-step guides for specific tasks |
| `/docs-tutorial` | Learning-focused tutorials with hands-on practice |
| `/docs-conceptual` | Explain architecture, design decisions, and mental models |
| `/docs-api` | API reference docs for endpoints, functions, and SDKs |
| `/docs-changelog` | Changelogs and release notes following Keep a Changelog |
| `/docs-troubleshooting` | Issue/solution docs with error message references |
| `/docs-review` | Four-pass review of existing documentation |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) or another AI agent that supports the [Agent Skills spec](https://agentskills.io/specification)

### Option 1: Claude Code Plugin Marketplace (Recommended)

```
/plugin marketplace add darylldoyle/docs-skills
/plugin install docs-skills@docs-skills-marketplace
```

### Option 2: Agent Skills CLI

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and [40+ other agents](https://www.npmjs.com/package/agent-skills-cli).

```bash
npx agent-skills-cli add darylldoyle/docs-skills
```

### Option 3: Manual

```bash
git clone https://github.com/darylldoyle/docs-skills.git
cp -r docs-skills/docs* ~/.claude/skills/
```

## Quick Start

After installing, ask your agent to write documentation:

```
/docs readme
```

This invokes the router, which selects `/docs-readme` and generates a README for your current project.

You can also call any skill directly:

```
/docs-api
/docs-tutorial for building a REST client
/docs-changelog
```

## Updating

**Plugin marketplace:**

```
/plugin update docs-skills@docs-skills-marketplace
```

**Agent Skills CLI:**

```bash
npx agent-skills-cli update darylldoyle/docs-skills
```

**Manual:**

```bash
cd docs-skills && git pull
cp -r docs* ~/.claude/skills/
```

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please [open an issue](https://github.com/darylldoyle/docs-skills/issues) to discuss changes before submitting a pull request.
